text: Implemented DualityKernels.crossGram with dense, diagonal/sparse, and policy-gated non-diagonal sparse coverage; routed PLSC, CCA, and RRR through one PairedGmd spine parameterized by Qx/Qy metrics; CCA/RRR ridge is folded into inverse Gram Q metrics; added D-weighted PLSC/CCA tests while identity-D R parity fixtures remain unchanged.
